pr_title: release-22.2: roachtest: fix knex nightly test
pr_body:
We recently upgraded the knex version under test, which introduced new tests that do not work on v22.2.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/108091
Release justification: test only change
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/108219)
